File:Heterodontosaurus TD.png.ImageDescription: Heterodontosaurus is a basal ornithischian dinosaur named for the three different types of teeth it had, including a pair of prominent tusks. It was a small dinosaur at about 1.5 m in length, weighing around 3 kg. Heterodontosaurus was a bipedal herbivore, and likely had a covering of long quills down its back and tail.
